title: Take the Pawn, Take the King
setup: The pawn on h7 is checking your king on g6, and your queen on c7 has the whole seventh rank.
hint: The king's last shield is a pawn your queen can reach, and your own king stands close enough to back the capture up.
explanation:
## The Idea

You are in check, and the move that answers it also wins the game. {{Qxh7#}} takes the checking pawn and lands beside the black king.

Your king on g6 guards h7, so the king on h8 cannot take the queen, and the queen covers g8 and g7. A check from the next square cannot be blocked.

When you are in check, look first at capturing the piece that gives it.
